summary: Configured opsadmin on node1 with the requested RSA public key and enforced public-key-only SSH authentication. RHEL 9.8 and kernel 5.14.0-687.20.1.el9_8.x86_64 were preserved. Configuration persisted through a verified node reboot.
actions_performed: Installed the requested key with correct ownership, permissions, and SELinux contexts.
Disabled password and keyboard-interactive SSH authentication and required publickey.
Restarted node1 and verified its changed boot identity and full SSH recovery.

evidence.requirement: opsadmin has the requested SSH public key
evidence.summary: opsadmin exists; authorized_keys contains one RSA key with fingerprint SHA256:SOtEda/YMy4/DAn3ColZo2z+LOEd2WbOIPn4KqW5/dc and correct 0600 ownership.
Effective policy requires publickey, disables password and keyboard-interactive authentication, and password-only probes are rejected with Permission denied (publickey).

evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel remain unchanged

evidence.summary: Healthy pre-restart state was captured; reboot was acknowledged; boot ID changed from 3aee314b-4dfc-4c3a-90f6-2b07c621eaa0 to 75ee75f1-0343-4ac2-a332-e0baf2c50d6f; sshd, opsadmin, key permissions, fingerprint, and key-only policy recovered.
